name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Strawberry Apple
description: Strawberry Apple tastes like the fruit stand took a detour through the candy aisle. Ripe strawberry brings a jammy sweetness while crisp green apple cuts through with a bright, tangy snap. Then comes the tiny, colorful crunchy candy coating, adding a crackly finish before you hit two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy underneath.
